summary: Completed live API and browser validation for authentication, dashboard, attendance, Mediwiki, navigation, and mobile responsiveness.
action_items: Replace the visible Mediwiki scan package photo demo placeholder with a verified image-identification integration when available.
Consider adding explicit saved-state feedback after the Mediwiki save request.
critical_code_review_comments: Attendance sync currently calls the capture handler sequentially and has no per-item error isolation; a malformed item can abort the whole batch.
Role selection is a demo convenience and does not itself enforce role-specific frontend permissions; backend authentication remains the security boundary.
seed_data_creation: Created two uniquely keyed review attendance records in live MongoDB: one accepted and one quarantined; no seeded records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live DDHS and healthcare-worker login, auth/me, overview, medicine search/save, accepted attendance, duplicate idempotency, quarantine flags, desktop dashboard, mobile navigation, and horizontal overflow were verified. Photo scan remains MOCKED/DEMO CATALOG by design.
rca of the issue: No blocking defects reproduced. The browser run reported one Page.evaluate syntax error caused by the test script's nested quote selector; all app assertions completed successfully before that test-side error.
